summary: Fourteen days to FreightWorks Expo. Ridgeline escalated today: 9 trucks double-booked at Reno, the CFO was copied, and Reno sync errors hit 4.2%. The ranking PR is merged, and the slot picker design is frozen. Harbor's reliability plan was sent, and its QBR is tomorrow. Pinecrest is still unsigned.

items.text: Ridgeline's Omar reported 9 trucks double-booked at Reno DC this morning, with drivers waiting at the gate. This is the third time this quarter. He copied Ridgeline's CFO. Renewal is Nov 20, health yellow.
Omar wants a call before noon today. Jordan created TW-134 for the call, due today.
Jordan opened TW-133 for the Reno double-booking fix, assigned to Arjun, high priority, due today, estimated 4h.
Reno sync errors were 4.2% overnight, all duplicates, the same pattern as TW-103. Sync was 1.6% on Oct 18. Sync work had been deferred unless it worsened. TW-103 is still todo.
Retry queue (TW-104) is running in staging. Nina's error-rate alert (TW-105) moved to in progress. Nina is on call this week; Arjun takes over the week of Oct 26.
Ranking PR #232 (TW-116) was approved and merged, so the earlier review blocker is cleared. Arjun is putting the ranking into the scoring API (TW-115, due Oct 28).
Expo demo screens 1 and 2 are done (TW-119, due Oct 30). Screen 3 needs the slot picker build.
Slot picker design is frozen as of today. Sam agreed to no more design changes, and Leila said changes after Monday won't make it.
The booth tablet flow uses the real slot picker, so Leila says it must be stable by next Wednesday (Oct 28). TW-117 is due Oct 29. She added TW-135, empty and error states, due Oct 29.
Maya will give Sam final pricing numbers by Friday. Sam needs them for the printed one-pager. The pricing page (TW-125) is in progress.
Jordan got Coastal's data from Grace. Anonymized Coastal numbers can go on the Expo demo screen. Maya plans a live demo on the big screen plus a tablet booking station.
Maya sent Harbor the reliability plan (TW-131 done). Jordan's QBR deck is drafted, with final numbers due tomorrow morning for the Oct 22 QBR. Renewal is Oct 30, 38% of revenue.
Coastal kickoff call is Thursday (TW-121, due Oct 30). Valley is still waiting on data access.
Coastal and Valley need API endpoint docs (TW-127, Arjun, due Oct 26, still todo) before they can go live.
Pinecrest Grocers (TW-126, due Oct 30) is unsigned as third design partner and wants a live demo first. Signing this week would meet the launch goal.
Expo invites to the 40 target accounts (TW-122, due Oct 28) are in progress with Jordan. Booth 412 is confirmed.
Arjun has backend candidate interviews Thursday and Friday (TW-110).
Maya's October investor update (TW-111, due Oct 23) is in progress.
